newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau's Jan-Oct 1996 merchandise trade falls.
newsitem.headline: Macau's Jan-Oct 1996 merchandise trade falls.

text.p: Macau's merchandise trade fell between January and October 1996, resulting in a trade deficit of 429 million patacas (US$53.6 million), the Statistics and Census department said on Tuesday.
The deficit worsened by 2.5 percent compared to the same period in 1995, it said.
Exports (fob) within the period amounted to 12.782 billion patacas, down two percent.
Imports (cif), valued at 13.211 billion patacas, were down 1.9 percent.
Exports of textiles and garments, which comprise 79.9 percent of Macau's overall export value, rose by a modest 1.6 percent while non-textile exports fell 14.1 percent.
Macau is a Portuguese-administered enclave due to revert to China in 1999. (US$1 = 8.0 patacas)
